question: Sensitivity to addition of recorded pre-tournament opponent ATP rank, not proof of absence of opponent effects.
main: Fixed original fold-specific ensemble membership; refit all parameters and grouped calibration after adding log2(opponent ATP rank).
secondary: Repeat all 4095 subset searches inside the existing 5x5 match-grouped nested CV after adding the same rank covariate.
covariate: log2 of opponent rank as of tournament start or most recent ranking before it; one scalar, no seed/year-end/current ranking substitution.
screen: Learn original technical-feature screening inside each fit; force context covariate to remain outside that screen, with no context-based dropping of technical features.
calibration: Original three-fold match-grouped Platt calibration of each learner; no post-ensemble recalibration or lambda experiments.
folds: Original StratifiedGroupKFold five outer / five inner / three calibration folds, shuffle=True, seed=42; all sets of a match stay together.
selection: Only development inner-OOF AUC; ties fewer members then original subset order; training-only Youden thresholds.
outcomes: AUC, Brier score and classification metrics
Technical-feature SHAP ranking and Backhand Returns attribution
2025 Backhand Returns ablation holding membership fixed
Paired AUC changes with whole-match resampling
explanations: KernelSHAP, training background of 50 (seed42), 2048 samples, l1_reg=0, seeds42/142/242; same protocol as original final-ensemble SHAP. Opponent context excluded from technical-only ranks and separately reported.
uncertainty: 2000 paired whole-match bootstrap draws; fixed fitted predictions, no bootstrap refit. Non-significance is not equivalence.
completeness: All71matches/239sets, no rank imputation, no case exclusions;36overlapping matches cross-checked against author CSV.
source: Third-party Jeff Sackmann data, archived by jmatarese/atp-data; not certified direct ATP export; CC BY-NC-SA4.0.
limitations: Ranking proxies opponent strength, not serve direction, handedness-specific patterns, injuries or tactical style.
Single-player retrospective sensitivity; no causal independence or absence-of-confounding claim.
